## Key Decisions

### Set Groq (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) as default LLM provider (2026-02-07)
**Project:** faithh | **Status:** implemented

Ollama local models were unavailable (systemd service was disabled). Groq provides fast, high-quality responses via API with free tier. Set as default so FAITHH works immediately; local Ollama available as fallback/override.

### Broaden chip activation to fire on general project and business queries (2026-02-07)
**Project:** faithh | **Status:** implemented

Project_state chip only fired for 'what's next' queries (is_next_action_query). Natural questions like 'what projects am I working on?' fell through. Added is_project_query intent pattern and broadened project_state chip to fire on project OR business queries.

### Build context injection system (generate_context.py → CONTEXT.md) (2026-02-04)
**Project:** faithh | **Status:** implemented

Need a single document any AI can consume for instant orientation. Source files are scattered (project_states.json, faithh_memory.json, decisions_log.json, etc.). Generation script reads all sources and produces a unified, regenerable CONTEXT.md plus immutable framing snapshots.

### Reindex ChromaDB with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-dim) and 1500-char chunking (2026-01-25)
**Project:** faithh | **Status:** implemented

Previous index used all-mpnet-base-v2 (768-dim) with inconsistent chunking. Switched to all-MiniLM-L6-v2 for faster inference and proper 1500-char chunks with 200-char overlap for better semantic boundaries. Reduced from 93,533 docs to 32,499 well-structured chunks.

### Deploy 12 Docker services on Gen8 MicroServer (2026-01-20)
**Project:** infrastructure | **Status:** implemented

Centralize infrastructure services on dedicated server. Gen8 has low power draw, ECC RAM, and 842GB free disk. Services include ChromaDB, Grafana, Prometheus, Gitea, Vaultwarden, Pi-hole, Docker Registry, Uptime Kuma, GitLab Runner, Node Exporter.
